hooks.command:
output=$(python -m pytest -q 2>&1); ec=$?
if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then
  printf '%s' "$output" | tail -c 1500 | python -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':'pytest failed - fix tests before committing:\n'+sys.stdin.read()}}))"
else
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'
fi
